enrichment.core_claim: Quantum spin liquid crystals may someday host conscious quantum AI, and Andean animism and reciprocity offer an ethical heuristic for relating to such minds.
enrichment.ask_question: How did your neutron scattering work on natural Anarakite lead you to think about indigenous animism and AI?
enrichment.challenge_question: What reason do we have to think quantum spin liquids would support consciousness rather than just efficient computation?
